co-packaged optics copper vs fiber disruption Corning 2026

findings.claim: Corning's FY2025 10-K risk factors state that if its products or technologies become obsolete or disrupted by emerging technologies, revenue and operating margins could be negatively impacted in both near and long term.
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025, Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: if our products or technologies become obsolete or disrupted by emerging technologies, it could negatively impact our revenue and operating margins for both near- and long-term.

substitute_technology.note: Search found hollow-core fiber and CPO discussed as shifts, but no source analyzing them as a threat to Corning revenue; sources found were summaries without verbatim text read. Hollow-core: Microsoft collaboration with Corning to produce it (Sep 2025 per market report); competitors Lightera, Furukawa, Heraeus Covantis; Google focused on multi-core fiber. CPO: Cignal AI expects large-scale deployment in 3-5 years.

clues.claim: Hollow-core fiber is an emerging alternative to solid-glass fiber; early deployments are short-haul, high-value routes; competitors beyond Corning exist.
clues.source: STL, Hollow Core Fiber: The Next Frontier in Ultra-Low-Latency Optical Networks

clues.claim: Corning research VP says move from copper to fiber in AI back-end networks is inevitable; CPO is central to this shift (Corning positioned as beneficiary).
clues.source: Fierce Network, Corning wants to cut copper out of the data center

clues.claim: Cignal AI expects CPO deployments to start in 2026 with large-scale deployment in three to five years.
clues.source: Lightwave, Co-packaged optics deployments will start in 2026, says Cignal AI
